sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 5XL+.
Increases damage when using a physical or magic attack Ability by S+.
Target: yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 5.
Increases physical and magic attack Ability success value by M.
Performs a critical hit.
Ability Power scales with the number of Water elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of 6XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
L
Activation rate scales with the number of Water elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).
